text:
maria: Heads-up — kicking off onboarding for cust Scallion's LoRA overlay on vesta-7b. Quick eval pack attached. Need tokenization sanity + int4 quant smoke. anyone available to run the first pass?

Derek: I can spin up a run on ded-gpu-03. are we merging upstream adapter or applying as overlay?

maria: overlay preferred for now. their adapter remaps a few currency tokens (euro, pound) — looks like token ids differ. sample mapping below. also want invoice extraction checks.

sophie: paste the mapping? i can whip a remap script.

maria: code:
```
{"€": 5023, "£": 5981, "$": 23}
```
we map to our ids in currency_map.json and run tokenizer remap.

Derek: starting smoke: `./run_eval.sh --model vesta-7b+scallion-lora --quant int4 --batch 8 --prompts eval_pack.json` — queued on ded-gpu-03.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: job 4621 queued on ded-gpu-03 (pool: dedicated, tag: smoke)

eval-bot: eval-bot: initial quick-eval results  (run 4621): fluency pass, invoice_amount extraction: 0.82 (baseline 0.95). example failure: `Total: €1,200` -> output `1200` (missing currency).

maria: ok that's the tokenizer remap symptom. @sophie can you run `remap_tokens.py --map=currency_map.json --inplace` then re-run the pack? also try pinning kv cache pad to 8 — we've seen small offsets in int4 kernels.

sophie: remap applied; updated pack and re-running. quick note: some negative/parentheses formats return different normalizations, i'll add those cases to the eval set.

Derek: re-run (job 4627) with kv_pad=8 and tokenizer override: `./run_eval.sh --model vesta-7b+scallion-lora --quant int4 --kv_pad 8 --tokenizer_override currency_map.json`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: job 4627 started on ded-gpu-03

eval-bot: eval-bot: run 4627 results: invoice_amount extraction 0.96, latency +2ms median, token usage +0.5% on avg. regression fixed, edge-case coverage increased.

maria: nice. recommendation: merge overlay with tokenizer-remap step in install, canary rollout 5% traffic, monitor invoice accuracy & latency for 24h, rollback threshold accuracy < 0.95. I'll open the rollout ticket.

sophie: i'll add a migration note and include `currency_map.json` in adapter README + install hook. also adding the negative/parens tests to the smoke pack.

Derek: i'll schedule the canary and add per-route traces to the console dashboard so we can correlate latency.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll attach the eval artifacts and open ticket INF-7823 with rollout plan. good job :party_parrot:
